title: Stream a DJI drone to several platforms at once (multistream)
description: Send one DJI drone live stream to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Twitch and Kick at the same time with DJI Live Bridge — free, local, no restream service.
h1: Stream a DJI drone to several platforms at once
lead: DJI Fly sends one RTMP stream. DJI Live Bridge receives it on your computer, encodes the picture once and forwards it to every destination you enable — TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, Kick or any RTMP server — without a paid restream service. If one destination fails, the others keep running.
summary: Add one destination per platform and switch on “Stream here” for each one you want.
The picture is encoded once, so more destinations do not need more processing power — only more upload bandwidth.
Plan about 10 Mbps of steady upload per destination (6 Mbps video plus headroom).
All destinations share one orientation: vertical for TikTok/Instagram, horizontal for YouTube/Twitch/Kick.
Everything runs locally; there is no third-party restream server and no monthly fee.

steps.d: In DJI Fly open GO FLY → ••• → Transmission → Live Streaming Platforms → RTMP and enter the address DJI Live Bridge shows.
Under Where do you want to stream? use Add another destination for every platform: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook have their own type; Twitch, Kick and others are Custom RTMP.
Instagram (and Facebook without a persistent key) need a new key for every broadcast. Use Update key on those cards.

steps.t: Pick the orientation for your main audience
steps.d: One encode feeds every destination, so choose Vertical 9:16 or Horizontal 16:9 for the platform that matters most.
Each destination card shows its own state — Live, Connecting or Connection failed — and one failure does not stop the rest. Press Go live on the platforms that need it (Instagram, Facebook).

blocks.p: On a phone hotspot in the field, two destinations are usually the practical limit. Test the connection with Try with a video file before you take off.

Some platforms limit simulcasting for partners or in their terms; Twitch in particular has changed its rules over time. DJI Live Bridge only sends the video you tell it to — it never signs in to an account or presses Go live for you.

faq.q: Can I stream my DJI drone to TikTok and YouTube at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. Add both as destinations and press START LIVE. Because both share one orientation, choose the one that suits your main audience.

faq.q: Do I need a restream service?
faq.a: No. DJI Live Bridge does the multistreaming on your own computer, for free; it only needs enough upload bandwidth.

faq.q: What happens if one platform drops?
faq.a: Only that destination shows Connection failed. The others keep streaming.

faq.q: Does each extra platform need more CPU?
faq.a: Hardly. The picture is encoded once and the same data is sent to every destination.

faq.q: Does multistream work in OBS mode?
faq.a: No. Several destinations are a feature of direct streaming; in OBS mode, OBS decides where the stream goes.
